x.body: In 1976, Chinedu and his wife, Amaka, left Nigeria for France with nothing but two suitcases and a dream. They eventually built a life in Lyon, raised three children, and had grandchildren who spoke French better than English. For fifty years, they never returned to Nigeria. Their children kept asking about the country their parents came from, but Chinedu always said, “One day, we will go together.” That day finally came when he turned 78.
